updates.title: AWS adds OpenAI GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna to Bedrock in GovCloud
updates.whatChanged: On 30 October, Amazon Bedrock added OpenAI GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna to bedrock-runtime in AWS GovCloud (US). Teams can call them through the Responses, Chat Completions and Converse APIs. Cross-Region Inference routes requests across both GovCloud regions. Bedrock provides invocation logs, CloudWatch metrics and per-model cost records.
updates.whyCare: GovCloud teams can use OpenAI's API formats with Bedrock's account-level logging, metrics and billing controls. Cross-region routing adds capacity and redundancy while maintaining US data sovereignty.
updates.before: GovCloud teams could not call OpenAI GPT-5.6 models through Bedrock runtime APIs or route requests across GovCloud regions.
updates.after: Teams can invoke GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna through the Responses, Chat Completions and Converse APIs on bedrock-runtime. They can route requests across both GovCloud regions with model-level logs, CloudWatch metrics and cost reporting.
updates.learn: Compare Bedrock-hosted GPT with direct OpenAI APIs and other Bedrock models. Test API compatibility, cross-region data controls, logging and spend attribution before moving regulated workloads.

updates.architectureImplication: Keep API contracts separate from runtime placement. Validate cross-region routing, data residency and telemetry in GovCloud. Compare those controls with direct OpenAI deployment and other Bedrock models.
